# PUT /api/v1/teams/{id}/repos/{org}/{repo}

Add a repository to a team

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** token · **ID:** `ep-066`

## Request

| Param | Location | Type | Required |
|-------|----------|------|----------|
| id | path | integer (int64) | True |
| org | path | string | True |
| reponame | path | string | True |

**Headers:** `Authorization`

## Response

**204** — empty

- **403** — user does not have admin-level access to the repository
- **404** — team or repo not found

## Business Rules

| Rule | Category | Condition |
|------|----------|-----------|
| Team membership or org ownership required to access team endpoints | authorization | User is not site admin AND not org owner AND not team member |
| Admin-level access to repository required to add/remove it from a team | authorization | User's access level to the repository is less than AccessModeAdmin |
| Repository must belong to the team's organization | validation | repo.OwnerID != t.OrgID |
| Adding a repo to a team is idempotent - no error if already present | business_logic | HasTeamRepo returns true (repo already in team) |
| Auto-watch repos for team members when adding repo to team (if setting enabled) | business_logic | setting.Service.AutoWatchNewRepos is true |

## Error Handling

| Trigger | Status | Response | Retryable |
|---------|--------|----------|-----------|
| repo name not found | 404 | not found | False |
| user lacks admin access | 403 | Must have admin-level access to the repository | False |
| TeamAddRepository fails | 500 | internal error | True |

### Error Paths

- **repo not found** → getRepositoryByParams → 404
- **user access < admin** → AddTeamRepository → 403
- **DB error in TeamAddRepository** → AddTeamRepository → 500

| idempotency | ✅ configured | low | Operation is idempotent - if repo already in team, returns nil (no-op) |
